headline: AI BOOM 💥 Could POP 🫧 Markets Says BANK 🏦 BOSS
text:
ANDREW 🧔 BAILEY the BANK 🏦 of ENGLAND 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 boss is straight up WARNING ⚠️ that this wild AI 💻 BOOM 🚀 could trigger massive MARKET 🏪 SHOCKS ⚡ and the UK 🇬🇧 needs to get PREPARED 🛡️ right now!! He's watching the WAVES 🌊 of CASH 💰 pouring into artificial intelligence "very carefully" 🧐 while reminding everyone that "not everybody always wins" 🏆!! The insane money spent and LOANED 💸 to AI firms over the last few years in hopes of HUGE 🍆 RETURNS is pumping some of them up to multi TRILLION 💰 dollar valuations like it's the next big climax 😩!!

Asked if he thinks an AI bubble could BURST 💥 Bailey said "You could see some correction of asset prices at some point" 📉 and bro the central bank is on EDGE 🪑 watching this whole thing like it's a marathon edging session 🕒!! Speaking exclusively to the BBC 📺 about risks and benefits for the UK economy he admitted the tech has "great potential to strengthen growth in our economies" 🌱 which is something the country desperately NEEDS 🥺!! But it also brings substantial RISKS ⚠️ so we have to be on TOP 🔝 of both the gains and the potential heartbreaks 💔!! One major risk is what happens if these BIG BETS 🎲 on AI don't pay off and leave everyone down BAD 😵‍💫!!

AI chipmaker NVIDIA is currently the world's most VALUABLE 📈 listed company with a jaw dropping market valuation of 5.5 TRILLION dollars thanks to investors who believe in the massive PROFITS 💰 AI could create!! Meanwhile tech GIANTS 🦸 Alphabet Meta Microsoft and Amazon are dropping HUNDREDS of BILLIONS 💸 on the technology like it's an all night RAILING session ⚙️!! And two of the largest AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI are preparing to SELL 📈 shares on the US stock market which many believe will send even MORE hundreds of billions flooding into the industry like a money SHOWER 🚿!!

"There is a large very large amount of investment going into this sector now" said Bailey "and of course that's natural because it's a major area of growth" 🌿!! "And of course you see that the asset prices of the companies that are developing it have gone up a lot" 📊 "and that reflects the fact that there are high expectations of what it can deliver" 🎁!! "Everybody is currently priced to be a winner" he added but warned that "you look back at the past not everybody is a winner" 🥈!! Google was not the first market leader in internet search it was NETSCAPE 🕸️ which nobody can even remember today because it doesn't EXIST anymore!!

"We are prepared for the fact that there will be I think some shocks come along to markets" ⚡ "and we have to deal with that" he stressed "We have to make sure the system is resilient" 💪!! Bailey also pointed to other RISKS from AI such as the technology being used for cyber attacks 🕵️‍♂️ which has created a "much more powerful way of uncovering vulnerabilities" in software!! "It's revealing things that have been in bits of operating software that we've had and all of us have had" 🧩!! "In the wrong hands it's a very powerful potentially very powerful weapon" 🔫 he added with a serious face!!

Another huge risk is the rise of DEEPFAKES 📸 AI made pictures and videos of people that look totally real and can fool the public!! Bailey has had first hand experience after deepfake images showed him and Nigel Farage in a physical FIGHT 🥊 getting promoted on X!! He told the BBC the fakes were done so well that the Bank has struggled to trace where they came from!! "We've got to be able to trace these things back" 🔍 "And we need a lot of help from the tech sector to do that" he begged!! On the brighter side Bailey said a big potential BENEFIT from AI is speeding up the work that supports the Monetary Policy Committee which sets interest rates!! "It's not taking a decision but it's a tool in the hands of the policy maker and that's good" 🛠️ he finished while the whole financial world holds its breath 😤!!
